baseline.title: Coexistence curve and critical point of the imitative monomer–dimer model
baseline.description: For the variational function in the pressure theorem, there is a critical endpoint m_c=2−√2,J_c=(3+2√2)/4,h_c=½log(2√2−2)−¼. A coexistence curve h=γ(J),J>J_c, has exactly two distinct nondegenerate global maximizers. Off that curve the global maximizer is unique; at the endpoint its second and third derivatives vanish and fourth derivative is negative. Away from the curve and endpoint it is nondegenerate.
